## Overview Exclude hidden terminal EOS/stop-token logprobs from sampled Chat Completions and Completions responses, in both Python and Rust frontends. Fixes #63591. AI assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted in preparing this PR. ## Claims - Streaming and non-streaming logprobs omit a terminal token hidden from the response text; explicitly visible stop tokens retain their logprobs. - Raw generated token IDs and completion-token usage remain unchanged. Echo-only prompt logprobs and length-limited output retain their final token. ## Validation Local hardware/model: NVIDIA RTX 3080 10 GB, Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B, float32, eager execution, GPU memory utilization 0.6. | Validation | Result | | --- | --- | | New Python API regression cases before the fix | 12 failed, 14 passed | | Python completion suite after the fix | 51 passed, including all 26 new cases | | Related Python logprob/offset tests | 12 passed | | Rust real-model API tests | 43 passed, including all 26 new cases; existing CI selection | | Rust server/chat tests | 510 server unit, 427 chat unit, 18 chat integration passed | | Pre-commit and Rust Clippy | Passed; Clippy with `-D warnings` | The baseline failures show text `A` with an extra terminal logprob (`['A', '<|im_end|>']` or `['A', '!']` rather than `['A']`). Tests constrain greedy sampling to a visible token followed by EOS/an explicit stop-token ID, and verify text, logprob arrays, original IDs, finish reasons, and usage. The Rust route test additionally checks 20 streaming/non-streaming visibility combinations and streaming usage through the scripted engine. ```text # Before the production fix: E AssertionError: assert ['A', '<|im_end|>'] == ['A'] E Left contains one more item: '<|im_end|>' 12 failed, 14 passed, 25 deselected in 82.22s # After, complete Python completion suite: 51 passed in 127.39s # After, Rust frontend using the existing CI selection: 43 passed, 8 deselected in 102.74s ```
Reproduction commands ```bash # Baseline: add the regression tests without the production fix. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion.py \ -k 'logprobs_match_visible_output or echo_only_logprobs' -v # 12 failed, 14 passed, 25 deselected # Python, with the fix: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion.py -v # 51 passed .venv/bin/python -m pytest \ tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py \ tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion_error.py \ tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion_text_offset.py \ -k 'logprob or text_offset' -v # 12 passed # Rust frontend, using the existing Buildkite selection: VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest \ tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion.py \ -k 'not test_single_completion and not test_prompt_logprobs_completion and not test_parallel and not test_batch_completions' -v # 43 passed, 8 deselected # Rust route regression (20 combinations): cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml \ -p vllm-server -p vllm-chat -p vllm-cmd \ --features vllm-cmd/native-tls-vendored --locked \ openai_logprobs_exclude_hidden_stop_tokens_without_changing_usage_or_token_ids cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml \ -p vllm-server -p vllm-chat -p vllm-cmd \ --features vllm-cmd/native-tls-vendored --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings ``` Rust 1.95 was used. The existing vendored TLS feature supplies OpenSSL on this machine. Server/chat unit suites and the chat integration suite were run directly from the test executables produced by `cargo test --no-run`; unit suites used one test thread. Other chat integration suites, including grammar replay, were not part of this validation.
## Details Detokenization can suppress a terminating EOS/stop-token ID while preserving the sampled IDs and logprobs internally. Response formatting previously emitted every logprob position. This change filters only the hidden terminal position at the OpenAI response boundary. Rust chat events carry the terminal reason alongside the matching token delta so streaming conversion can apply the same rule without buffering another chunk. String-stop truncation and beam-search behavior are unchanged. Existing synthetic tests that label visible ordinary tokens as EOS now terminate by length; their logprob assertions remain intact. The Rust echo test now omits its genuinely hidden final stop-token logprob. No model weights, sampling decisions, or engine accounting change. Duplicate check repeated through GitHub CLI before publication: issue #63591 is open with no comments or linked closing PR; open and all-state PR searches for `63591 in:body` returned no matches. Related #61693 concerns prompt logprobs, #60542 and #57442 change raw/sample-only logprob handling, and #62719 trims derender text while explicitly retaining logprobs. None implements this response-layer terminal-token fix. ---

 In order to use them, you can pass them as extra parameters in the OpenAI client.
 Or directly merge them into the JSON payload if you are using HTTP call directly.
 
+When sampling stops at an EOS or stop-token ID, `/v1/chat/completions` and
+`/v1/completions` omit its logprobs if the token is excluded from the response text
+(the default).
+To include that token in both text and logprobs, set
+`include_stop_str_in_output: true` and `skip_special_tokens: false` in `extra_body`.
+The `completion_tokens` usage count still includes the hidden terminal token.
+When token IDs are returned via `return_token_ids`, they also retain that token.
